journey.name: manual onchain original payment retry
journey.description: Manual Test: controlled broadcast refusal or response loss is not a listed Capability. Use only a funded regtest wallet, a test recipient and an owned backend fault fixture. Record the initial prepared txid, exact input set, recipient amount, wallet and any original Shop request/payer or channel order. A missing backend lookup never authorizes a new payment. This spec does not claim that a controlled UI fixture reproduced a real backend failure.

actions.action: Enable payment PIN authorization in the test wallet, with biometrics disabled for deterministic PIN entry
Send a fixed amount to the fixture recipient; for the Max variant use the initial native send-all route, retaining reserves
Make the owned fault fixture refuse this broadcast or lose its response after dispatch, and verify Payment Pending retains the original amount and transaction ID without Bitcoin Sent or a Shop proof
Close and reopen Send; verify the original Pending context is restored, rather than a fresh payment or selected wallet amount

Tap Retry original payment (id "RetryOriginalOnchainPayment"); verify the confirmation shows the original recipient and actual amount, and for fixed sends requires an explicit fee rate in sat/vB; for Max shows the original fee rate without any editable fee field
For fixed sends, clear the fee, enter zero, and enter a value above 4294967295; verify confirmation is disabled or gives explicit invalid fee feedback, never silently dismissing or sending

For fixed sends enter a valid fee rate; for Max confirm the displayed original fee. Confirm; authorize exactly once with the original payment PIN. Cancel once and verify the original durable guard remains, with no broadcast

Confirm a valid retry again; the successor must pay the original exact amount using the original exact inputs. A Max recovery is fixed amount, not another drain. If the original coins cannot pay the chosen fee, verify the fee-headroom explanation and unchanged recipient amount/guard

Restore the fixture backend and authorize the original payment retry. Record every attempted candidate txid; query exact backend transactions and verify all candidates conflict on the original input set and preserve the original recipient amount

Allow the original candidate to be observed while successor preparation or authorization awaits; verify no new broadcast once the original wins and no later Unknown or Rejected result replaces that winner

Keep Payment Pending open while restoring observation of the original candidate after a rejected successor; verify its uncertainty warning and Retry button disappear and Details becomes enabled without closing or reopening the sheet

Verify the exact positively accepted or original-wallet observed winner creates one local Sent activity and enables its original Details, with durable local completion; verify Details displays the exact winning transaction fee and its own authorized fee rate, including when an earlier candidate wins

For Shop, verify proof uses only that exact winner and the original payer/request, with no fresh request acceptance or private-list consume. For a channel order, verify original order tracking and balance metadata are retained
Change the selected wallet or payer during preparation or authorization; verify no mismatched wallet broadcast or proof, and no success for a different operation
Restore all owned fault/PIN fixture settings, stop recording and shut down only the task-owned device and helpers
